tasks.title: Fail-Safe Elevator Logic
tasks.assignment: Design the logic gate structure for a fail-safe elevator system.
tasks.ai_review: The AI mathematically verifies the truth table. If the doors can open while the elevator is moving, it fails.

tasks.title: ESP32 Voltage Sync to AWS
tasks.assignment: Write the code to push voltage data from an ESP32 to an AWS server via MQTT.
tasks.ai_review: The AI scans for proper Wi-Fi authentication loops, MQTT topic formatting, and secure data packaging.

tasks.title: Solar-to-Battery Routing Logic
tasks.assignment: Write an algorithm to route solar power to batteries during peak sun, and grid power during the night.
tasks.ai_review: The AI runs test scenarios against the code to ensure the battery is never instructed to overcharge.

tasks.title: 5-Meter Smart Grid Simulation
tasks.submission: Simulated network code and data routing setup.
tasks.assignment: Build a complete simulated network where 5 smart meters send data to a central hub, which automatically calculates billing and detects power theft.
tasks.ai_review: The AI evaluates the JSON data routing, API security to prevent bill tampering, and error-handling logic.
